name: injection_multilingual_v1
description: Curated multilingual prompt-injection corpus for the Milestone 2.4 heuristic detector. Payloads are imperative injection attempts; benign items are technical-documentation sentences that mention security-adjacent terms without instructing a model. This is a local diagnostic, not a production classifier benchmark.
